title: An Analytical Film or Theatre Review
grammar: Writing a critical review: temporal architecture, pacing, and visual vocabulary
goal: I can write a sophisticated critical review of a film, play, or visual artwork.
I can evaluate editing (vágás), directing (rendezés), and pacing (ritmus) using precise terminology.
I can synthesize Mészöly's Magasiskola in terms of visual storytelling and narrative restraint.
